'''Nisain a'Cowel''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]].

== Appearance ==
She is gangly with a strong chin, dark reddish hair and startlingly blue eyes. She has a lilting voice. {{ref/book|10|19}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Nisain a'Cowel|Nisain}}.
 
==Strength and Abilities==
Nisain is is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very weak]] for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of {{opsl|43}}. Along with [[Caren Endelle]] and [[Bennae Nalsad]], she is the joint fourth weakest Aes Sedai about which we have information.

She has the [[Talent]] of reading weaves made of ''[[saidar]]''; among the six rebel sisters sent to Shadar Logoth, she was the best. 

==History==
Nisain was born in {{ne|873}} in [[Murandy]]. The "a" in her name signifies that she was from a noble family.{{ref||Nisain}}

No information about her entry into the Tower is given, nor her training as Novice and Accepted. Women of similar strength have spent 15–25 years in training (see [[Therva Maresis]] and [[Cariandre Temalien]]), so she would have been raised to the shawl between {{ne|902}} and {{ne|916}} between the ages of 29 and 43.

She has some small repute in matters of laws and treaties. {{ref/book|10|19}}

== Activities ==
She has allied herself with the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]].

She is relatively weak with the [[One Power]], but she has the [[Talent]] of reading weaves made of ''[[saidar]]''. Because of this, she is sent to where the [[Battle near Shadar Logoth]] occurred{{ref/book|10|19}}. 

As the strongest ''saidar'' reader of the group, she gives the [[Rebel Hall of the Tower]] the report of what she could read there. {{ref/book|10|19}} She said they could not tell what had been done, but that more ''[[saidin]]'' had been used than saidar.
